scripts.build: export DEPLOY_ENV=local && ng build --configuration production,local && npm run postbuild:checks
scripts.build:ci: export DEPLOY_ENV=ci && node scripts/routes.mjs && ng build --configuration production,ci && npm run postbuild:checks
scripts.build:ci-showcase: export DEPLOY_ENV=ci-showcase && node scripts/routes.mjs && ng build --configuration production,ci-showcase && npm run postbuild:checks
scripts.build:fullstack: export DEPLOY_ENV=fullstack && node scripts/routes.mjs && ng build --configuration production,fullstack && npm run postbuild:checks
scripts.build:staging: export DEPLOY_ENV=staging && node scripts/routes.mjs && ng build --configuration production,staging && npm run postbuild:checks
scripts.build:prod: export DEPLOY_ENV=production && node scripts/routes.mjs && ng build --configuration production && npm run postbuild:checks
scripts.postbuild:checks: node scripts/postbuild.mjs && node scripts/gen-csp.mjs && node scripts/check-deploy-output.mjs && node scripts/check-csp.mjs && node scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs
scripts.lint: eslint . && stylelint "src/**/*.css" && node scripts/contrast-check.mjs && node scripts/check-no-commerce.mjs && node scripts/i18n-merge.mjs --check
scripts.i18n:extract: ng extract-i18n --output-path src/locales --format xlf && node scripts/i18n-merge.mjs
